system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Jade Warrior abilities, you must receive training from another Jade Warlord, and you must have at least one tempered ur-stone worn against your skin.

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

Your mastery of jade allows you to transform into a terrifying engine of destruction.

As an Action, you may encase your body in an armored construct made of jade energy.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • Your Size and the Range of your Melee attacks increase by +1.

  • Your Armor and Melee increase by +1.

  • Once per turn, when you make a melee attack, you may give your attack the Cleave trait, and cause it to ignore Armor.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, warriors will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.hFTlpSemmyNY3gEM]{Jade Warlord}
